mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it indicates a tightening monetary policy that increases borrowing costs, reducing corporate investments and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent decline in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months indicates a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when HOUST declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) over three consecutive months indicates disinflationary pressures, which can lead to a loosening of monetary policy and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when CPIAUCSL declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When real final sales (RSAFS) grow by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when RSAFS increases by more than 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200k.

mechanism_narrative: When both real final sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) increase simultaneously by more than 1% and 5% respectively in a month, it signals a broad-based demand surge, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% and HOUST increases > 5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when both RSAFS and HOUST increase by more than 1% and 5% respectively.
